title: Spike: render statement PDFs inside accounts-api
context: Customers ask support for PDF statements. accounts-api has no document generation today.

spike.question: Can accounts-api render a statement PDF with a library on the team's approved list, without a new service?
approach: Prototype one statement on a throwaway branch
outputs: A one-page decision note with one recommendation
A sample PDF made from fixture data

acceptance_criteria.when: the team reads the decision note
acceptance_criteria.then: it names one option, its licence, and whether a new service is needed
